| **Category** | **Content** |
|-------------|-------------|
| **Meta Goal** | Demonstrate |
| **Target Audience** | Professionals |
| **Duration** | 2–4 hours |
| **Version** | Blockchain |
| **Competence Objective** | From unconscious incompetence to conscious incompetence |
| **Module Objective** | At the end of the workshop, participants understand the impact of blockchain on their supply chain |
| **Essential Questions** | • Difference between blockchain vs non-blockchain supply chains<br>• Benefits of blockchain for supply chain management |
| **Anchor Question** | What set of technologies will revolutionize how we handle controlled logistics transactions in the coming years? |
| **Sections** | Intro<br>Logistics<br>Use case presentation<br>Play game<br>Efficiency analysis<br>Conclusion |
| **Teaching Tools** | PowerPoint<br>Role play<br>Readings |
| **Teaching Situation** | Presentation<br>Whole group discussion<br>Small group discussion<br>Pairs exercise<br>Individual reading<br>Simulation<br>Roleplay |
| **Entertainment** | Create urgency around the problem<br>Role play with delays, cheating, disorder<br>Freedom to experiment and fail |
| **Empowerment** | Move from no blockchain knowledge to impact awareness<br>Experience blockchain dynamics<br>Fail first, then learn how to recover |
| **Teaching Method** | Play the Beer Game<br>Efficiency analysis of a transaction process |
